storage: git-versioned JSONL datacore/sentinel2/chips_index.jsonl (metadata ONLY; the chips themselves are local binaries under datacore/sentinel2/chips/, GITIGNORED — ~2 MB/scene, regenerable from CDSE at ~1.4 PU/scene)
written_by: scripts/cdse_chips.py (Python, session-run; never on Railway — see cot.json _note on envelope-test coverage of Python writers)
source: Discovery: Element84 earth-search STAC (anonymous). Chips: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A via Sentinel Hub Process API on Copernicus Data Space (CDSE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET, free tier 10,000 PU/month)
license: Copernicus free/open data policy; attribution 'Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data'

field_map.sun_elev: solar elevation deg (null if source omitted — PR-3 skips, never guesses)
field_map.est_pu: estimated Sentinel Hub processing units spent
field_map.bbox: chip bbox lon/lat [W,S,E,N] — covers ALL measurable registry tanks (pinned by test_cdse_chips.py)
field_map.bands: band order in the UINT16 TIFF (B02/B03/B04/B08 as DN x10000, SCL raw)
field_map.pulled_at: acquisition timestamp UTC (month key for PU accounting)

confidence_model: RAW acquisition metadata — no derived quantities; per-scene quality = cloud_pct + sun_elev (low winter sun carries MORE shadow signal; see TANK-FILL v2 workup)
cadence: every usable Sentinel-2 scene (~weekly after clouds; gaps stay honest gaps)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). Tank-fill v2 PR-2 of 7 — feeds the PR-3 crescent estimator; readings will archive to a separate stream when built.
